china_race_dynamics.text: I do think that we need to win the AI race internationally. I'm a firm believer in that because I can see that because of the speed of which it operates and the increasingly rapid evolvement of this, that if you get the upper hand here, you're going to have space, you're going to have the arctic, things that we're still fighting for, superiority, and that we want to make sure we win.
